2609.16229.title: Test-Time Unlearning via Sparse Autoencoder
2609.16229.paper_summary: Machine unlearning aims to remove specific knowledge from a trained large language model (LLM) without retraining from scratch. Existing methods modify model weights via gradient ascent and its advances. While effective on certain benchmarks, these weight-based approaches exhibit a sharp forget-utility trade-off, where stronger forgetting of target knowledge can degrade model utility, and unlearned knowledge may reappear under post-unlearning fine-tuning or prompt attacks. We propose ARIA (autoencoder-gated inference-time unlearning), a test-time unlearning method that leaves model weights intact and gates access to unwanted knowledge only when generation enters a forget-related state. ARIA uses sparse autoencoder (SAE) latents to train a lightweight linear detector, then applies an interpretable intervention on triggered states with negligible test-time overhead. Empirical evaluations on TOFU, R-TOFU, and WMDP show that ARIA improves the forget-retain trade-off over weight-based baselines across both a thinking model (DeepSeek-R1-Distilled-Qwen-1.5B) and an instruction model (Gemma-3-1B-it), e.g., reducing WMDP-cyber forget-set accuracy significantly while keeping MMLU within 1% of the pre-unlearning model. We further introduce three post-unlearning adversarial attacks targeting weight-space and decoding-space recovery, and find that ARIA remains robust under all three, with forgetting changing by less than 1% under attack. A feature-level case study leveraging the interpretability of ARIA suggests that some retain degradation may reflect response styles underlying the unlearning data rather than leakage of the targeted knowledge itself, highlighting a potential source of bias in unlearning task construction.
2609.16229.paper_summary_zh: 機器遺忘旨在從訓練好的大型語言模型（LLM）中移除特定知識，而無需從頭開始重新訓練。現有方法通過梯度上升及其進展來修改模型權重。雖然在某些基準上有效，但這些基於權重的方法顯示出明顯的遺忘效用權衡，即對目標知識的強烈遺忘可能會降低模型的效用，而未學習的知識可能會在後續的微調或提示攻擊中重新出現。我們提出了ARIA（自編碼器門控推理時遺忘），這是一種在測試時的遺忘方法，保持模型權重不變，僅在生成進入遺忘相關狀態時門控對不需要知識的訪問。ARIA使用稀疏自編碼器（SAE）潛變量來訓練一個輕量級的線性檢測器，然後對觸發狀態施加可解釋的干預，幾乎不增加測試時的開銷。在TOFU、R-TOFU和WMDP上的實證評估顯示，ARIA在思考模型（DeepSeek-R1-Distilled-Qwen-1.5B）和指令模型（Gemma-3-1B-it）上改善了遺忘-保留權衡，例如，顯著降低了WMDP-cyber遺忘集的準確性，同時保持MMLU在預遺忘模型的1%範圍內。我們進一步介紹了三種針對權重空間和解碼空間恢復的後遺忘對抗攻擊，發現ARIA在所有三種攻擊下仍然保持穩健，遺忘的變化在攻擊下少於1%。利用ARIA的可解釋性進行的特徵級案例研究表明，一些保留的退化可能反映了基於未學習數據的反應風格，而不是目標知識本身的洩漏，突顯了在遺忘任務構建中潛在的偏見來源。
